findings.message: not formatted — every Satz file in the library is in the canonical layout; the command writes it and never changes meaning
version 0.1 has no row in tests/fixtures/smoke/../../../vendor/satz/presets/README.md's `## Changelog` — a version nobody can read the history of is a version nobody can adopt
declares the membership google_cloud_identity_group_membership.first — presets define groups, humans grant membership: who is in a group is the customer's decision and never the library's
adopting it costs an estate: Groups Admin (Google Workspace admin console) and cloudidentity.googleapis.com. `satz update-prerequisites <estate>` writes both

not checked here: the privacy shapes (organisation and project ids, e-mail addresses, domains). `scripts/check-names.sh` in a satz checkout is what rejects them today, and what must become a param before a pack leaves the machine it was written on
